definition: Direct material exposure to AI compute, cloud/data-center capacity, high-speed networking, or physical infrastructure specifically serving digital-compute demand.
inclusion_rule: Assign only when primary evidence explicitly connects the company/product/capacity to AI, cloud, data centers, hyperscalers, accelerated computing, or AI networking.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign merely because a company uses ordinary software, analytics, or automation.

definition: Generation, transmission, pipelines, storage, refining, midstream, or other physical energy infrastructure whose economics depend materially on supplying power or fuel.
inclusion_rule: Assign when primary evidence documents material generation/transmission/storage/refining/midstream assets or expansion.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign solely for energy consumption or generic sustainability initiatives.

definition: Material exposure to EVs, batteries/storage, renewable fuels, clean ammonia, low-carbon power, or minerals/materials explicitly tied to electrification or energy-transition investment.
inclusion_rule: Assign only when primary evidence explicitly links products/capacity/demand to electrification, EVs, storage, renewable/low-carbon energy, or transition projects.
exclusion_rule: Do not infer from general ESG language.

definition: Profitability or strategic value materially exposed to commodity/resource prices, constrained supply, resource royalties, agricultural inputs, metals, hydrocarbons, or fertilizer economics.
inclusion_rule: Assign when primary evidence explicitly documents price/supply/resource economics or royalty exposure.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign to firms that merely purchase commodities as ordinary inputs.

definition: Strong demand, limited supply, high occupancy/bookings/utilization, or material capacity expansion documented as central to the company's growth.
inclusion_rule: Assign when evidence shows demand persistence or supply constraints leading to manufacturing, property, fleet, network, generation, or other capacity expansion.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign for routine capex without documented demand/supply rationale.

definition: A material business-model shift toward advertising, subscription/DTC, marketplace, membership, connected services, paid sharing, or other scalable digital monetization.
inclusion_rule: Assign when primary evidence documents a material monetization or distribution-model transition.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign for ordinary e-commerce sales alone unless the evidence identifies platform/advertising/membership/DTC monetization as strategically material.

definition: Persistent or rebounding consumer demand for travel, live entertainment, destinations, or other experience-oriented consumption with pricing/booking/attendance evidence.
inclusion_rule: Assign when primary evidence documents bookings, attendance, pricing, or experience demand.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign to general consumer staples/retail without an experience-oriented demand mechanism.

definition: Real-estate or location-based economics supported by occupancy, leasing, demographic demand, redevelopment, or constrained physical supply.
inclusion_rule: Assign when evidence directly documents occupancy/leasing/demographic/supply-demand or redevelopment as a material economic driver.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign solely because the company owns real estate.

definition: A large acquisition, integration, divestiture, or portfolio restructuring materially changes scale, asset mix, market reach, or economics.
inclusion_rule: Assign when primary evidence describes a material acquisition/integration/restructuring as strategic.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign for small routine transactions.

definition: Recurring membership or subscription-like customer economics with documented renewal, member growth, or fee-income importance outside pure media streaming.
inclusion_rule: Assign when evidence directly documents membership scale, renewal, fee income, or loyalty economics.
exclusion_rule: Do not infer solely from repeat customers.

definition: Near-zero/expansionary monetary policy, large-scale asset purchases, or major fiscal support is a salient contemporaneous holding-window event.
inclusion_rule: Assign only with official policy/fiscal evidence during the holding window.
exclusion_rule: Do not infer accommodation from market prices alone.

definition: Rate hikes, an explicitly restrictive stance, or forceful anti-inflation guidance is salient during the holding window.
inclusion_rule: Assign when official Fed communication documents tightening/restrictive policy.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign merely because rates are historically high if policy stance is not evidenced.

definition: Rate cuts, explicit guidance toward easing, or a meaningful policy transition away from prior restraint is salient during the holding window.
inclusion_rule: Assign when an official Fed action or communication explicitly signals/implements easing.
exclusion_rule: Do not infer a pivot solely from falling yields or market expectations.

definition: Official inflation data show a meaningful contemporaneous slowing, flat/negative monthly headline CPI, or continued movement toward lower inflation.
inclusion_rule: Assign from official BLS CPI evidence indicating deceleration/disinflation.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign based on forecasts.

definition: Official inflation data or Fed communication emphasize inflation remaining elevated or sticky, including shelter/services pressure.
inclusion_rule: Assign when official contemporaneous evidence explicitly supports persistence/stickiness.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign solely because inflation is above 2% without supporting context.

definition: Official evidence shows solid labor-market or economic activity resilience as a salient part of the policy/inflation regime.
inclusion_rule: Assign from official labor or Fed evidence documenting resilient activity/employment.
exclusion_rule: Do not infer from equity-market returns.

definition: Official Fed communication explicitly highlights increased uncertainty, labor-market cooling, or a changing balance between inflation and employment risks.
inclusion_rule: Assign only when official Fed communication explicitly describes this changing balance.
exclusion_rule: Do not use generic uncertainty language from non-primary commentary.
